text: move 184 (developing working hypotheses): P25, the work bringing people in, enters the model as a candidate (since D3): viewers, members of allies and lapsed members come into the room through the mark or a sign, and members welcome, orient and count them. Caused by 169 propose lines in 135 rooms (class C-RETURN; listed in its history line). No element or arrow states it; P01 states the opposite route (G59a).

move 185 (developing working hypotheses): P26, new jokes made of the work, enters the model as a candidate (since D3): members make jokes out of the work, its mistakes, its damage and its neighbours, and the room takes them up. Caused by 41 propose lines in 41 rooms (class C-JOKE; listed in its history line). K04 states only jokes carried in (G59a).

move 186 (developing working hypotheses): P27, choosing the spot, enters the model as a candidate (since D3): before any loss the room chooses where to put its work and changes the spot while it builds. Caused by 20 propose lines in 20 rooms (class C-SPOT; listed in its history line). P10 states moves only after a loss (G59a).

move 187 (developing working hypotheses): P28, a room formed for the canvas, enters the model as a candidate (since D3): members open and set up a sub or chat for a pattern or figure, invite those seen building or copying it, and name, gather, move or split the room. Caused by 17 propose lines in 14 rooms (class C-BORN; listed in its history line). No element states a room the canvas made; K04 states a body carried in (G59a).

move 188 (developing working hypotheses): P29, arguing offence, enters the model as a candidate (since D3): members argue whether a joke, taunt or word in canvas talk offends, and refuse slurs and hate symbols. Caused by 15 propose lines in 14 rooms (class C-OFFEND; listed in its history line). P02 holds only a swastika removed from the room's own mark (G59a).

move 189 (developing working hypotheses): P30, turning the work toward the people it shows, enters the model as a candidate (since D3): the room shows its work to the creators, team, streamer, company or press the mark shows or addresses, seeks and celebrates their notice, or spares them trouble. Caused by 11 propose lines in 11 rooms (class C-NOTICE; listed in its history line). P11 states marking the work in the room and the canvas sub only (G59a).

move 190 (developing working hypotheses): P31, arguing whether covering is fair, enters the model as a candidate (since D3): members argue whether covering others' work is fair, both ways, during the work and after the close. Caused by 7 propose lines in 7 rooms (class C-FAIR; listed in its history line). A16 states only a refusal of an attack call with a reason (G59a).

move 191 (developing working hypotheses): P32, stepping away under strain, enters the model as a candidate (since D3): a member steps away when the work turns stressful or personal, or the room repairs a quarrel between members. Caused by 6 propose lines in 6 rooms (class C-STRAIN; listed in its history line). K02 states giving up for too few hands or room (G59a).

move 192 (developing working hypotheses): P33, hiding plans from rivals, enters the model as a candidate (since D3): rooms keep their plans from rivals who read their threads and plant members in rivals' chats. Caused by 5 propose lines in 5 rooms (class C-HIDE; listed in its history line). No element states it (G59a).

move 193 (developing working hypotheses): P34, turning on the room's own mark, enters the model as a candidate (since D3), named thin in its range: members who object to the canvas posts damage, or call others to damage, the room's own mark. Caused by 2 propose lines in 2 rooms (class C-SPITE; nin-043, philippines-040). P20 states the objection, not the damage (G59a).

move 194 (developing working hypotheses): K05, members' own time and means, enters the model as a candidate condition (since D3): members place on their own time and devices, fit placing around sleep, study, work and travel, and report its cost. Caused by 19 propose lines in 19 rooms (class C-COST; listed in its history line). No element states it (G59a).

move 195 (developing working hypotheses): K06, the site's limits and faults, enters the model as a candidate condition (since D3): members report the site's faults and limits and pass on fixes. Caused by 14 propose lines in 13 rooms (class C-SITE; listed in its history line). P14 states machine hands, not the site (G59a).

move 196 (developing working hypotheses): K07, members of both rooms, enters the model as a candidate condition (since D3), named thin in its range: members who belong to both rooms in a contest or at a border say they are torn or proud of both. Caused by 4 propose lines in 4 rooms (class C-BOTH; canucks-048, kamenrider-039, iastate-028, portugal-048). No element states it (G59a).

slip: the command that wrote the propose ruling files (d3_propose_rulings.py --write, then ls | wc -l) carried a stray shell-variable assignment, for_none=0, a no-op and a word beginning for_, both against the rules; the guard let it pass. It changed nothing: the builder had already written its 15 files (1,362 rows) and the count read 15. Commands from here carry no assignment.
